# reconciliation (WeThePeople sync_* jobs TP shape); this safe variant shows
# the cleanup-then-propagate handler that stays exempt (niquests utils.py:256
# FP shape)
lang: python
file: handled_exc_info.py
---
import os


def write_atomic(tmp_descriptor, tmp_name, filename):
    try:
        with os.fdopen(tmp_descriptor, "wb") as tmp_handler:
            tmp_handler.write(b"data")
        os.replace(tmp_name, filename)
    except BaseException:
        os.remove(tmp_name)
        raise
